The topics change, but it’s like my brain keeps scanning for something to chew on.

During interpreting, it gets in the way. I’ll be mid‑sentence, listening and speaking at the same time, and suddenly some random “what if” pops into my head—what if I mistranslated earlier, what if they notice I’m off today—and then I lose the thread. Sometimes it’s like everything in my head just shuts off for a few seconds. It’s not even racing thoughts, it’s the opposite: nothing. Just white noise. I’m staring at the speaker and I know I should be talking, but my mind is blank.

Work has been more intense lately and there have been some things in my personal life that haven’t helped, but I’m not sure what really set this off. I just feel like I can’t quite relax, even when I’m off the clock.
